prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1026; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with wrist pain and was evaluated across ten office visits. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision, and imaging and clinical findings support a wrist fracture. Initial examination showed localized tenderness, swelling, and reduced range of motion at the wrist, while several other tests performed during the course of care returned normal results. Treatment followed a conventional sequence: immobilization, pain management, and progressive therapy exercises. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and functional strength returned. No prior injury to the affected wrist or surrounding area is known from the patient's history or available records. Billed services align with the documented care plan, and no duplicate or repeated charges were identified. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, with return precautions provided should symptoms recur.
